description: One record per customer role across four classes.

classes.A: Mandated IIC seats - portal-enforced. No activity can be entered without them.
classes.B: Adjacent institutional offices - real, but outside the IIC portal.
classes.C: Off-portal gatekeepers - control the purchase; absent from the IIC portal and from todo.md's list. Added per D-019.
classes.D: Individual users - students and founders. Never institutional buyers.

fields.id: Stable role identifier. Class letter encodes the class.
fields.role_class: A mandated IIC seat / B adjacent institutional / C off-portal gatekeeper / D individual user.
fields.in_todo_list: True if the role appears in todo.md Phase 2's list of 12.
fields.todo_ref: The todo.md label it maps to.
fields.portal_enforced: True if the IIC portal refuses activity entry without this role.
fields.grades: Per-question evidence grade. Falls in confidence as the question approaches money.
fields.uses/decides/pays/approves: The four questions, answered in prose with a grade.
fields.official_responsibility: Quoted or closely paraphrased from a published IIC constitution.

honesty_guard: validation() FAILS the build if any role is graded DOCUMENTED on `pays` without citing a source in BUDGET_AUTHORITY_SOURCES - i.e. a procurement instrument that actually confers budget authority. Result: only 4 of 25 roles carry a documented `pays`, and none is a mandated IIC seat.
known_gaps: No source read establishes which budget head, if any, funds an IIC seat.
Procurement instruments come from 8 institutions found on public sites; not a sample.
Role incumbency is documented for a handful of institutions only.
